snippet.title: Kena: Bridge of Spirits Switch 2 Release Trailer
snippet.description: Kena: Bridge of Spirits will launch on Nintendo Switch™ 2 on March 26 in North America, Europe, and Asia, and in Thailand on March 25. Nintendo console players in North America and Europe who are eager to start their own journey with Spirit Guide Kena and her adorable yet powerful Rot companions can pre-order the game starting today in the Nintendo™ eShop.
